newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia gives offshore firms greater market access.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia gives offshore firms greater market access.

text.p: Offshore companies established in Tunisia have been allowed greater access to Tunisia's domestic market as part of efforts to attract foreign investment, officials said on Friday.

Under a law published in the last issue of the official gazetta, offshore firms are allowed to sell on the domestic market up to 20 percent of their production calculated on the basis of the value of their exports the previous year.
The foreign trade legislation applies to these goods when put on the domestic market, the law says.
Officials said the decision was taken to give Tunisian and foreign companies producing entirely for export priority access to the domestic market to back up their efforts to create jobs.
These firms are also allowed to open shops to sell their products, they aded.

More than a thousand companies with foreign capital are currently operating in Tunisia, of which 875 are devoted entirely for export, mainly in the textile, mechanical and electrical industry, chemicals and food processing.
